description: This Java class implements the UserService interface, providing CRUD operations and user-specific services by delegating to a UserDAO data access object.

classes.name: UserServiceImpl
classes.description: A service class implementing user-related operations, annotated as a Spring @Service and delegating data operations to UserDAO.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a User object via UserDAO.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of all User objects.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a User by its ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a User by its ID.

methods.name: findUserByName
methods.description: Finds a User entity based on username.

methods.name: changePassword
methods.description: Updates the password for a given User.
